newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian official reserves fall in August.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian official reserves fall in August.

text.p: Australia's holdings of gold and foreign exchange assets fell to US$17.247 billion in August from US$19.068 billion in July, compared with US$13.806 billion in August 1995, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.

In Australia dollar terms, reserves fell to A$21.807 billion in August from A$24.664 billion in July and A$18.350 billion a year earlier. The bank said that excluding valuation effects, it estimated assets fell A$2.2 billion in August.
"Most of this fall was attributable to the unwinding of some of the foreign currency swaps undertaken the previous month for domestic liquidity management purposes," the RBA said.
